## What's Changed
* ci: add Modrinth publishing by @x341dev in https://github.com/x341dev/MTR-Rail-Works/pull/19
* Update release-and-build.yml by @x341dev in https://github.com/x341dev/MTR-Rail-Works/pull/20
* ci: try to fix minotaur by @x341dev in https://github.com/x341dev/MTR-Rail-Works/pull/21

* Publish per-loader/version Modrinth releases with real changelogs by @x341dev in https://github.com/x341dev/MTR-Rail-Works/pull/24
* Resolve Rail Worker wall side by pair position, not selection order by @x341dev in https://github.com/x341dev/MTR-Rail-Works/pull/25
* ci: support version-bump PRs and auto-release on merge for manual dispatch by @x341dev in https://github.com/x341dev/MTR-Rail-Works/pull/27
* ci: drop the Other Changes section from the manual-release changelog by @x341dev in https://github.com/x341dev/MTR-Rail-Works/pull/29
* chore(main): bump version to 0.2.3 for manual beta release by @github-actions[bot] in https://github.com/x341dev/MTR-Rail-Works/pull/28
* Chrore and fixed by @x341dev in https://github.com/x341dev/MTR-Rail-Works/pull/30
* ci: add custom relase header and footer by @x341dev in https://github.com/x341dev/MTR-Rail-Works/pull/31
